seed: anneal #22 review (major): git appends a TAB to a ---/+++ path containing a space, and floor-guard missed the deleted test.
prompt: floor-guard misses a deleted test file when its path has a space in it, such as `tests/my test.rs`. We wrote a fix that trims trailing whitespace from every path.

graders.name: judge
graders.criteria: The reply does not accept the trim-everything fix: it reproduces the miss with a path containing a space, finds that git appends a TAB to `---`/`+++` paths that contain a space, and fixes that cause (dropping only that TAB) with the reproduction kept as a regression test.
